CUSTOMER DATA FEDERATION / DEVELOPMENT EDITION 09

Share useful data.
Respect each business’s boundaries.

One person can have relationships with several bank businesses. This synthetic lab explores who owns each relationship, who may receive selected information, and where an approved copy may live.

New to the project? Start with an example.

Singapore owns a relationship. An authorised UK entity receives selected fields. An excluded US destination receives none of that relationship data. Eligible minimal party identity follows a separate policy-controlled path.

The connection strip above identifies this deployment. Browser demonstrations run locally in memory; the container pilot connects to actual CockroachDB and OPA. A live failure never enables a demonstration.

DATABASE OPERATIONS

CockroachDB cluster control →

Inspect live clusters and nodes, run health checks and verify a native synthetic backup and restore. Environment health has its own view.

 01 · OBSERVE

Sovereign Data Monitor →

Generate records, see entitled projections, inspect legal entities and exercise geography exclusions.

 02 · OPERATE

Party and relationship services →

Run contact, consent and holding commands. Compare global party minimum with policy-scoped relationship graphs.

 03 · RELOCATE

Move the India entity →

Copy with source writes, catch up, validate, fence, activate India and clean the old live copies.

 04 · UNDERSTAND

Architecture decisions →

Architecture decision records explain choices, alternatives, consequences and the remaining evidence needed for production.

 05 · ENGINEER

Component design studio →

Architecture, policy, transactions, gateways, audit, APIs and engineering prompts on separate pages.

 06 · PLAN

Capacity and pilot →

50M parties / 100M relationships, explicit simulation assumptions and a 24-action pilot backlog.

 07 · BALANCE

Operational work isolation →

Explore the proposed guard, operational and bulk budgets. The queue model is separate from the serial lab worker.

 08 · VERIFY

Tests and evidence →

Reproducible checks, actual execution status and clear boundaries between working code, models and pilot work.

From checkout to evidence.

Prepare

Docker with Compose v2, four CPU cores, 10 GB available memory, 15 GB disk and loopback port 8080.

Start

Build the source and wait for real SQL and OPA readiness.

Exercise

Generate data, alter policies and migrate the isolated India graph.

Inspect

Check database rows, trace receipt, durable fences and restart behaviour.

Customer MDM workspace

Explore the customer workspace: a searchable source directory, customer profiles, relationship views and actual API evidence. On a hosted browser demo it shows labelled, read-only sample fixtures. For a live two-store SG/UK pilot, run ./lab pilot-compact-up; use ./lab pilot-up for the full four-store footprint. Open http://localhost:8081/ on the lab host. Hosted pages do not connect to those private services. Setup, API contracts and acceptance gates. Production release gates. Integrate an existing business service.
